Name: South Park ontology explainer
Description: The barebones South Park ontology from Jessica Talisman's explainer: ten stated facts and five rules that can each be switched on. Conclusions are formulas.

schema.name: CountOfConclusions
schema.Description: Facts that hold but were never stated.

Rules.Description: The five rules; IsEnabled is the checkbox.

schema.name: CountOfFirings
schema.Description: How many times the rule produced a fact.

data.Label: Inverse
data.Explanation: A parent link also gives a child link between the same two people.
data.Name: Inverse

data.Label: Symmetric
data.Explanation: A friend link or a spouse link is true for both people.
data.Name: Symmetric

data.Label: Property chain
data.Explanation: A parent of a parent is a grandparent.
data.Name: Property chain

data.Label: Domain and range
data.Explanation: An attends, has grade level or has role statement implies that its subject is a Person. The place attended is a School. This rule adds no role or grade value.
data.Name: Domain and range

data.Label: Disjoint
data.Explanation: In this example, no person is both the parent and the spouse of the same person.
data.Name: Disjoint

Things.Description: A node in the picture: a person, a place, a class or a role value.

schema.name: CountOfChildren
schema.Description: Added: a count, which a reasoner alone does not give.

Properties.Description: A kind of link, with the characteristics the rules use.

Statements.Description: A fact that is stated, or could be concluded: Subject, Property, Object.

schema.name: IsStated
schema.Description: Drawn as a solid line in the explainer.

schema.name: Holds
schema.Description: True when stated or concluded by an enabled rule.

schema.name: IsConclusion
schema.Description: Drawn as a dashed line in the explainer.

schema.name: WorkedOutBy
schema.formula: =IF(NOT({{IsConclusion}}), "", IF({{CountOfInverseFirings}} > 0, "inverse", IF({{CountOfSymmetricFirings}} > 0, "symmetric", IF({{CountOfChainFirings}} > 0, "property chain", "domain and range"))))
